scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build:backend: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true});"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true});"
